Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 14.33.43 (report dated Sept. 8, 2026) found code signatures for 7 known tracker SDK(s): Amplitude (analytics profiling), AppsFlyer (analytics), Facebook Login (identification), Facebook Share, Google CrashLytics (crash reporting), Google Firebase Analytics (analytics), Sentry (crash reporting). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
